name: The NeverEnding Show
source:
Lost in the woods and desperate for shelter, a young traveler stumbles upon a gate leading to a forgotten circus. Within, a girl named Berry welcomes them with open arms and a crooked smile – her charm both comforting and vaguely menacing.

[From [url=https://eriswary.itch.io/the-neverending-show]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位年轻的旅行者迷失在树林中，急需庇护，偶然发现了一扇通往被遗忘的马戏团的大门。里面，一个名叫贝瑞的女孩张开双臂，带着扭曲的微笑欢迎他们——她的魅力既令人安慰又隐约带有威胁。

[来自[url=https://eriswary.itch.io/the-neverending-show]Itch.io[/url]]
